name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
description: Income support of INR 6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments to small and marginal farmer families possessing cultivable land.
description_hi: कृषि योग्य भूमि रखने वाले छोटे और सीमांत किसान परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष 6,000 रुपये की प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय सहायता।
benefit_summary: INR 6,000 per year directly transferred to bank account in 3 installments of INR 2,000.
benefit_summary_hi: प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 बैंक खाते में 3 किश्तों (प्रत्येक ₹2,000) में सीधे हस्तांतरित।
required_documents: Active Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar
required_documents_hi: आईएफएससी कोड सहित बैंक खाता पासबुक
आधार से लिंक सक्रिय मोबाइल नंबर

criteria.description: Citizen must be an agricultural cultivator or farmer
criteria.explanation_on_pass: Citizen is an active farmer or cultivator.
criteria.explanation_on_fail: Occupation is not recorded as farmer.

criteria.description: Citizen family must own cultivable land holding
criteria.explanation_on_fail: Citizen does not own cultivable agricultural land.
criteria.explanation_on_unknown: Land holding ownership status is unknown.

criteria.description: Exclusion: Cannot be an income tax payer in previous assessment year
criteria.explanation_on_pass: Citizen is not disqualified by income tax exclusion.
criteria.explanation_on_fail: Excluded because citizen is an income tax payer.
criteria.explanation_on_unknown: Income tax payer status is unconfirmed.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
department: Ministry of Labour and Employment, GoI
description: Old age protection and social security pension scheme for unorganized workers.
description_hi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के कामगारों के लिए वृद्धावस्था सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन योजना।
benefit_summary: Assured monthly pension of INR 3,000 after attaining 60 years of age.
benefit_summary_hi: 60 वर्ष की आयु पूर्ण होने के बाद प्रति माह ₹3,000 की सुनिश्चित पेंशन।
required_documents: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account with IFSC
required_documents_hi: बचत बैंक खाता / जन धन खाता पासबुक

criteria.description: Entry age must be at least 18 years
criteria.explanation_on_fail: Age is below minimum requirement of 18 years.

criteria.description: Entry age must not exceed 40 years
criteria.explanation_on_pass: Age does not exceed maximum entry age of 40 years.
criteria.explanation_on_fail: Age exceeds 40 years (scheme entry age is 18 to 40).

criteria.description: Citizen must work in unorganized sector (e.g. daily wage, street vendor, domestic worker)
criteria.explanation_on_pass: Occupation qualifies as unorganized sector worker.
criteria.explanation_on_fail: Organized or salaried government/private employment disqualifies from PM-SYM.

criteria.description: Monthly income must be INR 15,000 or less
criteria.explanation_on_pass: Monthly income is within the INR 15,000 ceiling.

criteria.description: Exclusion: Cannot be covered under EPFO, ESIC or NPS
criteria.explanation_on_pass: Citizen is not covered by formal EPFO/ESIC schemes.
criteria.explanation_on_fail: Excluded due to existing formal EPFO/ESIC/NPS membership.

criteria.description: Exclusion: Cannot be an income tax payer
criteria.explanation_on_pass: Citizen is not an income tax payer.
criteria.explanation_on_fail: Excluded because citizen is an income tax payer.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development, GoI
description: Maternity benefit cash incentive program for pregnant women and lactating mothers for improved health and nutrition.
description_hi: गर्भवती महिलाओं और स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं के स्वास्थ्य एवं पोषण सुधार के लिए मातृत्व लाभ नकद प्रोत्साहन योजना।
benefit_summary: Cash incentive of INR 5,000 for 1st child (or INR 6,000 for 2nd child if girl) paid in installments upon ANC checkups and institutional vaccination.
benefit_summary_hi: पहले बच्चे हेतु ₹5,000 (या दूसरी बालिका शिशु हेतु ₹6,000) स्वास्थ्य जांच व टीकाकरण पर किश्तों में।
required_documents: Bank Account Passbook in Mother's name
required_documents_hi: माता के नाम पर बैंक खाता पासबुक

criteria.description: Applicant age must be 19 years or above
Beneficiary must be a pregnant woman or lactating mother
criteria.explanation_on_unknown: Maternal status (pregnant or lactating) is unknown.

criteria.description: Exclusion: In regular employment with Central or State Government or Public Sector Undertakings
criteria.explanation_on_pass: Applicant is not in regular government employment.
criteria.explanation_on_fail: Excluded due to regular employment with Government/PSU (statutory maternity benefit applies).

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (पीएम-जय)
department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, GoI
description: Flagship public health assurance scheme providing cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover.
description_hi: गरीब व कमजोर परिवारों तथा 70 वर्ष से अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य बीमा।
benefit_summary: Health insurance cover of up to INR 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
benefit_summary_hi: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष अस्पताल में भर्ती व उपचार हेतु ₹5,00,000 तक का स्वास्थ्य बीमा।
required_documents: Ration Card or Family Identification Document
Income / Deprivation certificate (or age proof for senior citizen track)
required_documents_hi: राशन कार्ड या परिवार पहचान पत्र
आय / पात्रता प्रमाण पत्र (अथवा वरिष्ठ नागरिकों हेतु आयु प्रमाण पत्र)

criteria.description: Annual family income should be within INR 2,50,000 or qualifying deprivation (universal for citizens aged 70+)
criteria.explanation_on_pass: Annual income is within the qualifying limit (INR 2,50,000).
criteria.explanation_on_fail: Annual income exceeds INR 2,50,000 standard threshold (unless eligible under universal senior citizen track).

name: State Crop Disaster Relief (Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahayata) [Demonstration]
name_hi: मुख्यमंत्री किसान सहायता योजना (आपदा राहत) [प्रदर्शन योजना]
state_applicability: Participating States (e.g. Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar)
description: Financial compensation for registered farmers suffering documented crop losses exceeding 33% due to drought, unseasonal rainfall, or natural pest attack.
description_hi: प्राकृतिक आपदा या सूखे से 33% से अधिक फसल नुकसान झेलने वाले किसानों हेतु राज्य-स्तरीय त्वरित मुआवजा।
benefit_summary: Direct crop relief assistance up to INR 20,000 per hectare for affected agricultural acreage.
benefit_summary_hi: प्रभावित कृषि रकबे के लिए ₹20,000 प्रति हेक्टेयर तक की प्रत्यक्ष आर्थिक सहायता।
required_documents: Crop Sowing Certificate / Patwari crop loss verification report
required_documents_hi: फसल बुवाई स्व-घोषणा / पटवारी फसल क्षति सत्यापन रिपोर्ट

criteria.description: Citizen must be an agricultural cultivator or farmer
Farmer experienced crop loss or natural damage (>33%)
criteria.explanation_on_pass: Documented crop damage or natural hazard loss confirmed.
criteria.explanation_on_fail: No crop damage reported; scheme is disaster-loss triggered.
criteria.explanation_on_unknown: Crop loss / natural hazard status is unknown.
